verdicts.reason: Both crop the crowd into a hard-edged box that slices figures at the left and right edges, where the original bled off the canvas, and both use loose 6-line headline leading. A's headline ends on a weak two-word last line ('EVER HAS.') and leaves a heavy empty band at the bottom. B is worse in two ways: its last line is the single orphaned word 'HAS.', and its wider type and attribution run close to the right edge, which thins the margins.
